description: Expand each geometry by a distance, producing a polygon buffer. Drop-in for Alteryx's Buffer / Trade Area tools.

outputs.description: Same columns; geometry_column is replaced with polygon buffers

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a (Geo)DataFrame with a geometry column

projected_crs.label: Projected CRS
projected_crs.description: Projected CRS used for the buffer math. Default is Web Mercator (EPSG:3857).

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.description: Number of segments per quarter-circle in the resulting buffer polygon

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps
